_comment: cron-job.org bulk import config. Import these jobs at https://cron-job.org. Set the URL to https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/api/cron/{path} and add request header 'x-cron-secret: YOUR_CRON_SECRET'. All times are UTC.
_setup: 1) Generate CRON_SECRET: openssl rand -hex 32. 2) Set CRON_SECRET env var on your Next.js app (Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables). 3) Sign up at cron-job.org (FREE). 4) Create each job below with the specified schedule + URL + header. 5) Method: POST (or GET — all routes accept both). 6) Replace YOUR-DOMAIN.com with your actual domain (e.g., fieseros.com).
_architecture: This file contains ONLY the 4 HIGH-FREQUENCY crons that need sub-daily cadence (5-min / 15-min / hourly). The 9 DAILY crons + 1 MONTHLY cron are handled by the Vercel Master Cron at /api/cron/master (configured in vercel.json). Do NOT duplicate the daily crons here — that would cause double-execution. See README-cron-setup.md for the full architecture diagram.
_domain_placeholder: Replace YOUR-DOMAIN.com with your production domain (e.g., fieseros.com) before importing.

jobs.name: scheduled-messages
jobs._comment: Dispatches due ScheduledMessage rows (appointment / payment / overdue / follow-up reminders). Time-critical — late runs = customer reminders arrive late.

jobs.name: scheduled-executions
jobs._comment: Fires due delayed workflow automations (replaces setTimeout in trigger-engine). Time-critical — late runs = workflows fire late.

jobs.name: campaigns
jobs._comment: Dispatches scheduled email campaigns whose scheduledAt has passed. 15-min cadence is acceptable for marketing.

jobs.name: appointment-reminders
jobs._comment: Schedules customer reminders for upcoming JobVisits (1h / 24h / 2d before). Has 24h lookahead window so hourly is plenty.

jobs.name: featured-location
jobs._comment: Standalone hourly cron (NOT wired into master). Picks a random European city (population-weighted) from DirectoryLocation and stores it as the current FeaturedLocation, which the homepage reads to render the 'Featured European location' hero. Stagger from appointment-reminders by ~5 minutes if cron-job.org allows offset (or run both at :00 — they're independent and idempotent).

_monthly_crons_handled_by_vercel_master: sms-quota-reset (runs only on the 1st of each month via date guard in master route)
